content:
zoe: Opening a small PR to add an 'Airgap KMS proxy migration checklist' — will include minimal SDK checks, SNAT examples, and an MTU troubleshooting tip for HSM UDP paths. Need one infra + one docs reviewer.

kai: drop link when ready and call out any env var name changes. we need to coordinate deprecation messaging.

zoe: draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5032 (draft). changes: rename OLD_KMS_PROXY -> KMS_PROXY_URL, add TLS_CA_PATH/TLS_CLIENT_CERT envvars, add quick sanity checks.

michael: add a tiny curl + ruby snippet for proxy checks. curl is great in air-gapped infra. also include recommend MTU 1400 if HSM over UDP shows packet loss.

zoe: snippets:
```sh
# curl check via proxy
export HTTPS_PROXY=http://10.0.1.8:3128
curl -v --proxy "$HTTPS_PROXY" https://kms.internal/healthz
```
```ruby
# ruby minimal
require 'net/http'
uri = URI('https://kms.internal/healthz')
req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
req['Proxy'] = ENV['HTTPS_PROXY']
res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: true) {|http| http.request(req)}
puts res.code
```

airgap-bot: link-linter: broken anchor in /installers/airgap_kms.md -> #old-proxy-config. Suggest update to #kms-proxy-env or remove.

kai: please add a short migration note: how to fallback (clear KMS_PROXY_URL and restart installer), and a deprecation timeline. ping ops-oncall and security.

ops-oncall: will validate HSM UDP behavior and run socat checks in staging. also confirm SNAT examples. prefer nft on modern distros, but include iptables fallback.

zoe: added SNAT examples and a one-line explanation. iptables/nft: minimal examples included in PR. splitting into two commits: examples+checks, then link fixes+migration note. tagging reviewers tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
